sources.label: Independent accountant AUP report for Rupiah Token collateral - January 31, 2026

reserveReview.rationale: The January 31, 2026 independent accountant AUP (Johannes Juara & Rekan / Hari Manurung CPA) reconciles Rp94,232,212,766 of bank collateral to total issued Rupiah Token with an explicit 1:1 ratio and states procedures obtained bank statements and time-deposit certificates for each collateral account. Re-search on 2026-08-08 of rupiahtoken.com and public S3/attestation paths found no newer issuer-published reserve report, so the January 2026 AUP remains the latest usable primary-source breakdown. The snapshot is 189 days old as of the review date, so it sits outside the 31-day V9 admission window.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Independent accountant agreed-upon procedures over Rupiah Token bank collateral as of January 31, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No direct reserve category is unidentified. Bank identities, account balances, the time-deposit share, maturity terms, and legal custody safeguards are undisclosed.
